about: Where the XNK figure files come from (task C-08). They are build outputs of the XNK repo and are never edited by hand here; tools/check-figures.mjs fails when a sha256 changes. To update: copy the new build output from the XNK repo, record its commit, and change the sha256 in the same commit.
